# Glossary

<!-- Preamble, which is ignored. -->

## Zebra

Out of alphabetical order.

## Apple

First alphabetically but second in the file.

## apple

A duplicate term, differing only in case.

## Two paragraphs

The first paragraph.

The second paragraph, which is one too many.

## Cache

The first entry with this exact term.

## Cache

A second entry with the same exact term.

It has two paragraphs, which only shows if the duplicate is read separately.

## Renamed twice

The definition.

Formerly *First Name*.
Formerly *Second Name*.
